name: Single-Layer Ternary Depth Test
aliases: Ternary Depth Test for Surface Reconstruction
definition: A prior approach that maintains only a single surface layer per pixel, using a ternary depth test to blend or discard incoming fragments based on their depth relative to the stored value.
summary: The Single-Layer Ternary Depth Test is a rasterization technique for point-sampled surfaces that maintains only one surface layer per pixel, distinguishing itself from multi-layer approaches by strictly limiting visibility to a single depth value.
